expected_level_description: You can: - communicate design strategy across organisational boundaries - coach others in how to effectively communicate design - develop or introduce more effective methods of communicating design and working in the open

You can: - improve the practice of inclusive, accessible and environmentally sustainable design in multiple teams or across your organisation against measurable criteria - help others understand and mitigate potential barriers, biases and assumptions that may exclude or harm users

You can: - work with leaders to ensure that design is part of developing organisational strategy, and involved early enough in policy, technology and delivery processes to inform effective decision making - enable use of patterns and components across the organisation - help teams align their work to the goals and vision of their organisation

You can: - effectively plan and run design sessions that include senior leaders or stakeholders - coach other designers in how to involve stakeholders of any level in the design process - develop or introduce more effective ways to design together - help teams connect and work across organisational boundaries

You can: - embed a practice of hypothesis-driven design in a team - guide the organisation in how to use evidence to improve content or services - analyse, synthesise and use evidence to improve the way the organisation works - ensure user insights are shared with and used by the wider organisation and across government

You can: - embed the practice of iterative design and agile working in teams or wider organisation - guide designers in creating materials to test complex ideas at any fidelity - help teams adapt quickly to changes in requirements, priorities or user needs - iterate delivery processes or team structures to help teams work effectively

You can: - set a vision for and lead design across multiple teams or a whole organisation - work effectively with senior leaders across your organisation or wider public sector - support a culture of learning and experimentation in your organisation - iterate and measurably improve design maturity within your organisation and its partners

You can: - shape organisational strategy using a deep understanding of the health and care system - represent the organisation with health and care partners and leaders - anticipate how policy and service changes will affect digital services and care
You can: - set inclusion strategy and hold the organisation to account for it - lead culture change on equality, diversity, and inclusion

You can: - lead data protection impact assessments and information sharing agreements - advise teams on lawful basis, consent, confidentiality, and retention - investigate incidents and recommend improvements

You can: - lead hazard identification and risk assessment for a product or change - write and maintain hazard logs and clinical safety case reports - agree risk controls with product teams and check that they work - advise teams on applying clinical risk management standards

skill: Designing for clinical safety and human factors
expected_level_description: You can: - apply human factors methods, such as task analysis and use-error analysis, to complex clinical workflows - design to reduce alert fatigue and cognitive load across a whole service - provide design evidence for clinical safety cases and usability evidence for regulated software
You can: - lead managers and shape the culture of a large area - design workforce plans and organisational change - coach leaders and resolve complex people issues
You can: - track spending against a small budget and raise variances - authorise spending within your limit
